title: VPC Subnet Mapper & Probe-driven Egress Manager Terraform Module
creator: Aisha Patel
description: Create a reusable Terraform module that manages VPC subnets (AZ-aware), route tables, NAT/IGW egress patterns, and VPC endpoints with built-in upgrade-safe lifecycle and probe-driven health checks. The module should support multiple deployment profiles (prod/canary/dev), enable safe rolling upgrades for route/egress changes, and emit CloudWatch metrics/alarms to integrate with Console observability. Provide clear defaults for high-availability and cost trade-offs, plus a migration strategy for existing private deployments.
acceptance_criteria: Module exposes variables for subnet CIDR mapping per-AZ, subnet tags/purpose (control/data/ingress/egress), and route table association
Supports two egress strategies: managed NAT Gateway (default) and lightweight NAT instance pool for low-cost tiers; operator can toggle per-subnet or per-environment
Creates VPC endpoints (S3, ECR, DynamoDB, SSM) optionally with prefix-based route injection and idempotent lifecycle behavior
Health probe system that runs cross-subnet connectivity checks (synthetic HTTP/ICMP) and updates a reconciliation resource that can trigger automated failover to alternate NAT in same AZ
Module implements upgrade-safe patterns: create_before_destroy, controlled route table swaps with traffic drain window, and a canary toggle for route changes
Automated smoke tests (terraform plan/apply in a sandbox account) and integration tests run in CI. PR must include tests and sample configs
Documentation (Confluence + README) with migration steps, cost guidance, and rollback playbook
No infrastructure changes in existing production deployments without an explicit canary rollout and sign-off (traced in Console)
